summary.answer: Builds the WZ back HUD children including team/player/ammo/inventory/compass/collapse/reinsertion/death notifications. Spawn selection hides deployable notifications; dead+not hacked+not spawn-select gates DeathCamContainer. KilledBy is locally always hidden; killer identity is hidden outside killcam, binds Attacker and updates emblem/name/rank views only for nonnil data. Overall caster-profile/spawn-select hides are separate predicates. The constructor wires child source contracts; it does not reconstruct every child, event producer or server state.

summary.answer: Builds fall-meter background/ground/threshold/player indicators. Nonnil ground altitude updates ground-fill geometry through exact helper expression; altitude/parachute-open altitude update respective TopPct using GetFreeFallAltitudeRatio. freeFallStartAltitude subscriptions call full-path callbacks to re-read each primary model, not reuse the notification's value. HiddenPreference delegates altimeter UI/profile setting; Visible tests insertionJumpActive, and settings/input models only request reevaluation. Registers close, optional postload, returns self. Ratios, units, fall physics and native image/timer behavior stay external.
